| `lei-organica/` | Lei Orgânica do Município de Apucarana (1990) and every amendment the Câmara's SAPL records | one per period of vigência (20) |

**The Lei Orgânica with its history.** The Câmara's SAPL keeps the Lei Orgânica as a structured text with a view of the text in force for each period between amendments, so each amendment is a commit on the day its period starts, credited to the Emenda à Lei Orgânica that gave it.

State law is in [brazil-parana-law](https://github.com/lexifina/brazil-parana-law); federal law is in [brazil-law](https://github.com/lexifina/brazil-law).
dates: The first version of the Lei Orgânica is the text SAPL gives in force from 1990-04-05. Each later version is dated by the first day of the period of vigência SAPL gives it and credited to the act SAPL names for it ("Dada por ..."); a period SAPL starts without naming an act is committed as a publisher commit, not guessed. Commits are at noon in Apucarana.
built: Each SAPL view of the Lei Orgânica becomes one file per Art.; each provision is one line, its label followed by its text; headings stand above the first article under them. The notes SAPL keeps under a provision or links into it ("Inclusão feita pelo ..."), provisions it marks as superseded, the amending acts' own blocks it shows inside the text and amendment notes typed into the text ("(Redação dada pela Emenda ...)") are left out.
limits: The record is SAPL's: a version is only as exact as the Câmara's text for it. Ordinary and complementary laws are not in yet. The text is not the official version: only the Diário Oficial do Município is authoritative.
build: built: the law of Apucarana from the Câmara Municipal's SAPL
